appDescription.message: 오늘 유튜브에 쓴 이용 시간과 시청 시간을 유튜브 화면 위에 실시간으로 보여줍니다.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown on the Chrome Web Store and extensions page.

usageLabel.description: Overlay label: total time the YouTube tab is focused (browsing, searching, comments included).

watchLabel.description: Overlay label: time a video is actually playing.

range7.description: Range toggle: show the last 7 days.

range30.description: Range toggle: show the last 30 days.

range90.description: Range toggle: show the last 90 days.

todayUsage.description: Summary tile: usage time accumulated today.

todayWatch.description: Summary tile: watch time accumulated today.

avgUsage.description: Summary tile: average usage time per active day in the selected range.

noData.description: Shown in place of the chart when the selected range has no records.
